rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for an appraisal or evaluation.

example.english: The company carried out a risk assessment before deciding to invest.
example.traditional: 公司做咗風險評估，先至決定投資。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 zou6 zo2 fung1 him2 ping4 gu2 sin1 zi3 kyut3 ding6 tau4 zi1

rows.note: Use this for the amount of tax or duty that has been assessed.

example.english: My tax assessment is much higher this year.
example.traditional: 今年我嘅稅額高咗好多。
example.jyutping: gam1 nin4 ngo5 ge3 seoi3 ngaak6 gou1 zo2 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use this for the official act or process of assessing tax, rather than the resulting amount.

example.english: The tax office has completed the tax assessment.
example.jyutping: seoi3 guk6 ji5 ging1 jyun4 sing4 ping4 seoi3
